test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error. 

The easiest way to make pasta is to be followed Chef Kapoor’s instructions on YouTube.
solution:
The correct answer is 'to be followed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in 'to be followed' part of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence should be written in '**to + infinitive**' form in **Active voice**.
 
• **Infinitives** are a **special form of verbs** that can be used as a noun, adjectives, or adverbs.
 
 
• They are usually made by **adding** the word '**to**' **before the base verb**, and they can be useful when **discussing actions without actually doing the action.**
 
 
 
• **Structure: Subject + verb + noun / pronoun + to + V1 + Object **(Active Voice)

 **Object + verb + noun / pronoun + to + be + V3 + Subject** (Passive Voice)
 
 
• *Example: Is anybody going to invite me? (Active Voice)

 Am I going to be invited by anybody? (Passive voice)*
 
 
 
• **V1 form** of **followed** is '**follow**'.
 
• Therefore, '**to be followed**' part in the sentence should be replaced with '**to follow**' to make it grammatically correct.

 

Correct Sentence: *The easiest way to make pasta is **to follow**__ Chef Kapoor’s instructions on YouTube.*
